description: Read OpenVibe.Community's resource index (ADR-048, plan T13 step 8, person-owned resources): GET /api/v1/resources lists a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1) of two kinds. community.paste: id the paste's slug, named by its title, state its visibility (public, unlisted, private), owner its owner_subject; deleted pastes are left out. community.space: id the space's slug, named by its name, state its visibility (public, members, staff), owner the person who created it. Both belong to people, not projects, so they carry no project_id and no OVRN, and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn answers 404 for every name. Filters: kind, owner (a usr_/agt_ subject id; what that subject owns), project (always empty here), cursor, limit.
